correctness.rationale: Both cubic graphs are explicitly constructed with ten labelled vertices. Each has exactly 3^10=59049 states. The exact transition for every state is stored in a 236196-byte little-endian certificate and independently recreated by Python and C++; the two different functional-graph algorithms produce identical cycle, basin, first-entry and sharp cutoff counts. Every state is classified by exhaustive traversal, not statistical sampling. Backtracking enumerates all adjacency-preserving bijections to derive the 23 and 6 symmetry classes. The certificate includes checked exceptional-cycle and sharp-transient witnesses. No infinite-family extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The pair GP(5,1), GP(5,2) comprises the two natural order-ten cases of the generalized Petersen construction: the pentagonal prism and the highly symmetric Petersen graph. Their identical order and cubic degree conceal a rigorous period-7 versus period-8 substitution and differing sharp transient cutoffs, with a substantial reversal of which attractor basin dominates. Classifying all labelled attractors and the 23 versus 6 spatial orbit types provides useful natural finite dynamical invariants, not an arbitrary slice or an extrapolation to all generalized Petersen graphs.
